title: MAMBench Provenance Graph Export
description: EXPORT-ONLY schema for ProvenanceGraph.to_dict() (phase3/evaluation/foundations/provenance_graph.py). This is a snapshot format for handing to a visualization tool or Phase 4 analysis code -- it is never read back as authoritative input. The only way to obtain a ProvenanceGraph object is build_provenance_graph()/build_multi_boundary_provenance_graph() over the live CanonicalMemoryLedger/CanonicalEventLedger/SupersessionLedger. See provenance_graph.py's own module docstring for the full grounding/authority discipline this schema does not itself enforce.

node_id.description: Canonical benchmark-owned identity, optionally namespaced 'boundary_label::canonical_id' for a multi-boundary graph. Never a vendor/foundation-native id.

attributes.description: Node-type-specific fields. For 'memory': canonical_id, memory_type, creation_timestamp, creation_event, lifecycle_state, lifecycle_status ('CURRENT' or 'AT_CREATION_ONLY'), superseded_by. For 'task': canonical_id. For 'memory_version': canonical_id, memory_id, version_number, lifecycle_state, superseded_by, recorded_at. For 'experiment_boundary': boundary_label.

established_by_event_id.description: The real CanonicalEvent id (or, for derived_from, the child memory's creation_event string; for has_version, the version's own established_by_event_id) that grounds this edge. Never null for a real graph -- every edge is grounded, per provenance_graph.py's own central invariant. within_boundary edges carry no event grounding (they are structural, not event-derived) and are the one legitimate case where this is null.

task_id.description: Required (non-null) for retrieved/selected/rejected/used/counterfactually_influential edges; must be null for every other edge type.
